Landscape financing

A landscape is a capital project. Pay for it like one.

We work with Acorn Finance, where you can apply and get payment options from multiple lenders — several offers side by side, rather than one number to take or leave.

Check my options at Acorn Get an estimate first

How it works

Get the estimate first. Then decide how to pay for it.

Financing is easier to think about when you know the number. Estimates are free, so the sensible order is: we come and look, you get a real figure, and then you decide whether to pay it at once or over time.

Acorn is a marketplace rather than a single lender. You submit once and see what several lenders will offer you. Checking your options does not commit you to the project, and it does not commit you to us.

Three steps

  • Get your free estimate from Blue Fox
  • Apply once through Acorn Finance
  • Compare the offers that come back and choose

Rates, terms and amounts are set by the lenders, not by us — so we do not quote them here.

Worth saying plainly

The one fee, and when you get it back.

Estimates are free. As of 7/1/2023 landscape digital design work is $250.00, with a 50% deposit. If the landscape package is approved, the $250.00 is credited toward the landscape project.

Questions

About paying for the work.

Does applying affect my credit?

That is Acorn's process rather than ours, and they explain it on their own application — which is why we link to them rather than describe their terms second-hand.

Do I have to finance through you?

No. Acorn is an option we offer because customers ask for one. Pay however suits you.

Can I finance a washing job as well as landscaping?

Ask us. Financing generally makes sense on construction-scale work; a single washing visit usually does not need it.

Is the $250 design fee financeable?

Raise it on the estimate call. It comes back to you as credit against the project if the landscape package is approved.
